Product overview
Your idea. A working app.

Atomic is an AI app builder from Abstract Machines that turns plain-language ideas into web applications, with visual editing, previews, source access and publishing.
The Atomic home screen · a drafted prompt in a sample workspace
Start with the app you have in mind
Describe a booking service, shop, client portal or internal tool. Start from your own words or explore a working template, then review and refine the result.
atomicapp.dev · Press room and complete media kit

Canvas theme controls · shape the appearance of a sample salon app
Describe. Shape. Publish.
Build and refine through conversation; preview the result as you work.
Explore screens on the Canvas, edit selected elements and tune colours, type, spacing and shape.
Leave feedback in context and collaborate with your team.
Inspect source and version history, then publish a release you have reviewed.
Atom provides identities, permissions and application data. A source download contains code; it does not export app users, business data or hosting infrastructure.
